name: odoo
description: Connect Claude to your Odoo: search, read and update customers, sales, invoices, products, stock, projects and more.
long_description:
Lets Claude work inside your company's Odoo.

Ask things like "show me this month's overdue invoices", "which quotations are waiting for Azure Interior?", "how much did we sell per salesperson in Q3?" or "create a lead for Acme and schedule a call".

Claude uses your own Odoo login, so it can only see and do what you can. Turn on **Read-only mode** if you want Claude to look but never change anything.

Works with Odoo Online, Odoo.sh and self-hosted Odoo (version 13 and newer, Community or Enterprise). The connection method is chosen automatically for your Odoo version.

odoo_url.title: Odoo address
odoo_url.description: The web address where you log into Odoo, for example https://mycompany.odoo.com

odoo_login.title: Email (your Odoo login)
odoo_login.description: The email address you use to sign in to Odoo.

odoo_password.title: Password or API key
odoo_password.description: Your Odoo password. If you use two-factor authentication or sign in with Google/Microsoft, create an API key in Odoo instead (click your name > Preferences > Account Security > New API Key) and paste it here.

odoo_db.title: Database (optional)
odoo_db.description: Leave empty: it is detected automatically. Only fill it in if 'Check my Odoo connection' asks for it.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: When on, Claude can look at Odoo data but can never create, change or delete anything.

insecure_ssl.title: Accept self-signed certificates
insecure_ssl.description: Only for internal Odoo servers that use a self-signed SSL certificate.
